settings.title: MORE THAN INCENSE.
settings.lede: Incense for real rooms and real moments, with nothing poured on top.

settings.title: The bad stick.
settings.text: Somebody lit a stick from a gas-station counter. Ten minutes later the room smelled like a candle shop on fire. We opened every window, and one question hung around longer than the smoke: why does nearly all incense smell like perfume?

settings.title: The fix.
settings.text: Most of it is soaked in fragrance oil. So we went the other way: aromatic wood, a plant-based binder and nothing poured on top. What you smell is what’s burning. We lit a lot of test batches on porches, in garages and in living rooms. Two made the cut.

settings.title: The name.
settings.text: Every crew has a friend with a nose for it, the one who knows what’s in the room before their coat is off. We put a moustache on him, called him Mr. Sniff, and made him the boss. He’s never once been wrong about a smell.

settings.heading: HOW MR. SNIFF’S GOT ITS NOSE.
settings.lede: It started the way most good ideas do: a few friends, a late night and one very bad stick of incense.
settings.sign: Two scents. One nose. Come get a whiff.
settings.image_alt: Bonfire and Yoga Studio boxes on a stack of books beside a moustache holder with a burning stick

settings.quote: Incense shouldn’t smell like a perfume counter, and it shouldn’t take itself so seriously. Real wood, nothing poured on top and a little personality in every burn.
settings.name: The Mr. Sniff’s crew

settings.heading: Good incense sets the mood.
settings.text: We make incense for real spaces and real moments. From slow evenings to last-minute resets, every scent has a scene to call its own.
settings.image_alt: Man in round sunglasses holding a lit incense stick under his nose

settings.heading: Two scents. On purpose.
settings.text: We'd rather make two great scents than twenty forgettable ones. Bonfire for after dark, Yoga Studio for the reset. New ones show up only when they've earned a spot.
settings.image_alt: Bonfire and Yoga Studio boxes on driftwood with resin and palo santo

settings.heading: Nothing precious about it.
settings.text: Incense doesn't need to be serious to be good. We keep the ingredients honest and the jokes a little crude, so lighting one feels like a good time, not a ceremony.
settings.image_alt: Man in white sunglasses and a yellow leather jacket holding an incense stick

settings.heading: OUR POINT OF VIEW
settings.lede: Good scents. A little personality. Here's what goes into making Mr. Sniff's different.

settings.label: Aromatic wood powder
settings.text: Gives every stick its naturally smoky, warm character.

settings.heading: WHAT GOES INTO IT
settings.lede: Real wood, simple ingredients, and a whole lot of character in every burn.
